'''Post 994-203''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] post on [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. During the [[Mission to Metalorn (Galactic Civil War)|Mission to Metalorn]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] overcame the Stormtrooper on duty at Post 994-203 and stole his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].
